lines.t:
An <c:ffff00>attack<c> <c:ffff00>sub-skill<c> for <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> with special ammo or
mechanisms that greatly boosts <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c> on {{terrain}} with
plentiful water.
Preparing it drops the <c:ffff00>action<c>'s <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> by 50%.
If, when <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> completes, the <c:ffff00>{{field}}<c> is <c:ffff00>{{waterside}}<c> or
<c:ffff00>{{underwater}}<c>: <c:ffff00>{{power}}<c> +20, <c:ffff00>evasion<c> {{success_rate}} 0%,
and always <c:ffff00>{{critical}}<c>. Otherwise, a normal attack.
